on_pass: verdict pass: on both genuine calls NEW reproduces OLD by the declared rule and each maker reproduces its live call; the hand search change may be proposed for adoption with the timing readings
on_fail: verdict fail: OLD and NEW differ on a bound, genuine captured call; the change is not adopted and the differing quantity is investigated; the result goes to the overseer through the review bridge
on_invalid: verdict invalid: no pass is recorded and the hand search change is not proposed for adoption on this result; result.json lists every reason; the coordinator reports the result to the overseer through the review bridge; nothing is repeated automatically: a new capture or a repeat needs the decision
